description: 한국수자원공사_광역정수장 슬러지 정보 [drinking water supply] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국수자원공사. 한국수자원공사가 제공하는 광역정수장 슬러지 정보 데이터는 정수 처리 과정에서 발생하는 슬러지의 발생 현황과 처리 실적을 정리한 자료입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국수자원공사. Its tags are 정수처리과정, 슬러지정보, 발생현황, 정수장운영, 연도별변화. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-08-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
